summary: The First Den is a forest world centered on Spawn: a home and garden above a lake, with nearby activity sites and roads to Lumenvale and Hearthmere. Authored scene rows provide the places and actors; terrain marks, seeded procedural builders, and shared player/UI behaviors supply the landscape and interactions.
places: places/main - the forest world: Spawn/home and creek, lake and pond islet, garden grounds, wizard tower, and long roads to Lumenvale east and Hearthmere west
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn hub and grounds: home, creek, garden/mandala and alchemy bench, compost corner, firepit, forecourt, grotto, tower and zipline, plus Sage's route manager
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - lake shore and forest: fishing pier/tackle, lilypad hop and seed pouch on pond islet, shore vegetation/boathouse, and surrounding fauna
places/main/cells/objects.scene - shared placements for authored roads and city structures; other cells hold streamed structures, actors and relationships
places/main/config.yaml - forest height/material generator, water, site/path/clearing marks and decoration layers; paths grade ground and clear scatter independently of scene paving
roots: world.config.yaml - world entry: main place, camera/player templates, arrival behavior, input actions and UI renderer
templates/player.js#player - player character root with movement, locomotion, interaction, delete, travel and alchemy behaviors
places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - main heightmap and terrain/material interface
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#cob-house - Spawn's tree-centered multilevel cob home and furnishings
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#alchemy-bench, #mandala-crystal, #grotto, #zipline - harvest/brewing, exploration and ride activity roots
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene#fishing-pier, #pond-islet - lake fishing and lilypad/seed exploration site
scripts/gen/hearth-city.js + scripts/gen/lumen-grand.js - procedural builder roots for authored Hearthmere and Lumenvale city rows
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - main heightAt(ctx)/materialAt(ctx) contract for terrain and terrain-relative scene placements
scripts/gen/forest-plant.js + scripts/gen/valley-mesh.js - seeded vegetation geometry reused by configured decoration layers
scripts/lib/road-solid.js + scripts/lib/solid-kit.js - shared solid/collider construction reused by road and newer site builders
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - player press targeting and interaction tuning
scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js - mount/seat/dismount coordination used by Violet, rowboat, courier horse and zipline trolley
scripts/lib/data/hearth-city.js + scripts/lib/data/travel.js + scripts/lib/data/courier.js - shared city layout, destinations and courier route/tuning data consumed by builders, behaviors and UI
scripts/lib/data/alchemy.js + scripts/lib/data/pond.js + scripts/lib/data/zipline.js - centralized recipe, lake-activity and trolley tuning for their behavior/UI consumers
scripts/lib/sage-route.js + scripts/lib/data/sage.yml - Sage flight route and timing/greeting data read by scripts/sage-dragon.js
notableExports: scripts/forest-terrain.js - GROUND, SITES, LAKE, heightAt(ctx), materialAt(ctx)
scripts/player.js - onSpawn(ctx), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/camera.js - update(ctx,dt)
scripts/ui.js - default(ctx, player), HUD for travel, courier, secrets and alchemy
scripts/sage-dragon.js - onSpawn(ctx), fly(ctx), ears ('sage:fly', press), update(ctx)
scripts/zipline.js - ears.press, onSpawn(ctx), update(ctx); scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js - wantMount(ctx,target), dragonRide(ctx)
scripts/fishing-tackle.js - ears.press, reel(ctx,p); scripts/pond-seed.js - onTriggerEnter(ctx,other), ears.press, reshow(ctx)
scripts/gen/hearth-city.js + scripts/gen/lumen-grand.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx); scripts/gen/deer-fence.js - procedural fence geometry/collider
ownership: places/main/config.yaml + scripts/forest-terrain.js - terrain seed/material bands, water/site/path marks, clearings, grading and scatter layers
places/main/cells/*.scene - authored IDs, transforms, tags, initial state, parent-child relationships and fixed placements
scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - player movement intent, velocity, jump, flight, rope and camera mode; movement scratch remains in ctx.session
scripts/alchemy-player.js + scripts/lib/data/alchemy.js - player harvest spending, alchemy panel/toast, buff expiry, speedMul and potion aura; scripts/player.js consumes speedMul
scripts/pond-seed.js + scripts/fishing-tackle.js + scripts/lib/data/pond.js - player seeds/gotSeeds and fish count; each seed's visibility/respawn and fishing casts/catch results
scripts/mandala-crystal.js - per-player cooldown and player.state.harvest; scripts/grotto-chest.js - player.state.eggs discovery and chest lid state
scripts/sage-dragon.js + sage.yml - Sage flight/greeting/press phases and transient reach row; scripts/zipline.js + zipline data - trolley phase, rider, rope endpoints and progress
scripts/ui.js - presentation of player state and place courier status; it renders state but does not own gameplay values
flows: places/main/config.yaml terrain generator + seed -> scripts/forest-terrain.js heightAt/materialAt(ctx) -> engine terrain, river channels and forest material bands
terrain site/path marks + decoration layers -> grading, clearing, ground materials and seeded vegetation; scene rows independently draw visible roads and structures
move/look/jump/camView input -> scripts/player.js -> movement, jump, flight and camMode; templates/player.js also attaches home interaction, travel and alchemy handlers

player presses mandala-crystal -> scripts/mandala-crystal.js -> player.state.harvest; alchemy-bench press -> player.state.alchemyOpen -> alchemy-player brew action spends harvest and sets buff -> scripts/ui.js renders panel/status

player walks through pond seeds / opens pond-pouch -> scripts/pond-seed.js -> player.state.seeds and gotSeeds; fishing-tackle press/cast -> fishing-tackle reel -> player.state.fish and pond catch feedback
grotto-chest press -> scripts/grotto-chest.js -> lid animation, one-time player.state.eggs discovery and milestone; chest child lid is its animated geometry
sage:fly event or sage manager schedule -> scripts/sage-dragon.js follows sage.yml route via sage-route; proximity can create sage-reach -> home-player-feel press -> Sage pat/treat response
player presses zipline launch -> scripts/zipline.js asks dragon-rider to seat rider -> trolley traverses sagging world endpoints, then writes dropAt and returns
player mountWant -> scripts/lib/dragon-rider.js -> mounted entity seat/rider state and parent transform; Violet, rowboat, courier and zipline supply their own ride motion
horse press / courierRide -> scripts/courier.js and courier data -> player picker, road-mark route, rider dropAt and place.state.courier; scripts/ui.js presents picker/status
travel input/actions -> scripts/travel.js + travel data -> player travel state/teleport; scripts/ui.js renders destination list and emits travelGo
grand-gate-leaf-a/b proximity -> scripts/grand-gate-leaf.js -> per-row swing state and open/close sounds; scripts/gen/grand-gate.js supplies frame/leaf geometry and colliders
behaviorFamilies: places/main/config.yaml decoration layers + scripts/gen/forest-plant.js / valley-mesh.js - seeded forest flora varied by layer, kind and terrain
scripts/gen/cob-house.js + scripts/gen/cob-furnish.js - tree-centered multilevel home and furnishing family varied by item, dimensions, palette and seed
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js - bridge geometry/collider varied by dimensions and seed; terrain roads separately supply irregular gravel edges
scripts/gen/deer-fence.js - perimeter runs/gates vary by points, width and style, including coursed limestone wall details
scripts/gen/animal-{bear,deer,fox,wolf}.js + fauna-ground.js and critter builders + fauna-small.js - shared large/small fauna behavior varied by species and animation
scripts/gen/hearth-city.js + hearth-city data; scripts/gen/lumen-grand.js - procedural city structures/lots varied by city layout and kind
scripts/gen/shore-kit.js + scripts/material-shore-sway.js - authored shore/creek lilies, reeds and rim plants share geometry with GPU sway varying by kind and seed
scripts/gen/{alchemy-bench,compost-corner,fishing-pier,grotto,mandala-crystal,zipline}.js - interactive site geometry families varied by part/kind and placement; behavior scripts supply each activity
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses forest-terrain
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene behavior row attaches this actor script; scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js geometry may still be used
migrationNotes: forest-terrain heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main river is at sea level y=0, ground is around y=0.5, and Spawn clearing is centered near (0,-3).
Keep terrain material IDs, clear/flatten marks and decoration bindings coordinated with scene placement; Spawn/home grounds are near (0,-27), while other grounds and cities are separate sites.

Terrain path marks grade/materialize routes and clear scatter; scene road/path builders draw visible paving and do not replace those terrain jobs. Courier route road keys must stay aligned with the road-<city> marks.
Sage's route in scripts/lib/data/sage.yml is measured against colliders and consumed by sage-route.js; keep authored route and newly mapped sage-rear/sage-snap clips coordinated with its behavior.
Zipline state.a/state.b are world endpoints and its s/sag tuning is in metres; it seats through dragon-rider and drops the rider at the configured end, so retain endpoint/seat/drop coordination.
Alchemy consumes player.state.harvest (mandala source); seeds and gotSeeds are per-player while seed visibility temporarily respawns for others. Keep these separate from fish and egg counters.
